evidence: EXECUTED-HERE: pytest tests/architecture -> 8 failed; 6 are AttributeError: module 'fastapi.routing' has no attribute 'iter_route_contexts'
aura_backend/requirements.lock:587 fastapi==0.141.1 vs venv fastapi 0.136.3 / starlette 1.2.1
CI runners not assigned since 2026-10-28 (CB-44, DOCUMENTED ONLY)
current_behavior: Six invariants error before asserting; CI does not run; docs/guides/api-reachability.md cannot be regenerated or checked locally.
expected_behavior: Every merge proves all /api/ routes are under /api/v3, the admin surface cannot browse user content, every uncalled route is triaged, and the auth/IDOR sweeps pass.

title: Ingestion-family Celery tasks are published to a queue no worker consumes
evidence: deploy/docker-compose.prod.yml:747-911 workers consume -Q realtime | ingestion,learning | training
aura_backend/services/drive.py:166 ingest_pdf_task.delay (router not mounted in aura_service.py:124-139)
current_behavior: .delay() lands on Celery's default 'celery' queue; no worker consumes it; the returned task id never runs.
expected_behavior: Tasks run on the ingestion queue they are named for, or the dead routes are removed (GAP-013).
recommendation: Add queue="ingestion" to the three decorators or remove the dead learning/drive paths; add a unit test asserting each registered task's queue is consumed by a compose worker.

title: Railway target codifies only the gateway; outbox drain, insights, briefings, workspace reaper and idempotency purge depend on hand-created workers/beat
current_behavior: Whether worker-realtime/worker-ingestion/beat run on Railway is UNKNOWN; no manifest, no CI check, status docs silent. If absent, durable events accumulate unconsumed and no scheduled job runs.
expected_behavior: The background tier of the production control plane is declared in-repo and its presence is asserted by the deploy's health verification.
recommendation: Expose beat heartbeat age and outbox backlog on /admin/status; fail control-plane-deploy's health step on a stale heartbeat; record in BACKEND_STATUS.md whether the three services exist today.

title: Two stacked per-IP rate limiters key on different addresses; on Railway the legacy one likely collapses all users into one 100 rpm bucket
current_behavior: On the VPS both limiters see the real peer via nginx. On Railway, if the edge peer is not loopback, request.client.host is the proxy for everyone and the legacy limiter throttles the whole deployment collectively at 100 req/min.
expected_behavior: One limiter, keyed on the trusted-proxy-resolved client address, on every target.
recommendation: Remove the legacy RateLimitMiddleware from aura_service.py (the aura_core limiter is already wired) or key it with extract_client_ip; set --forwarded-allow-ips to Railway's edge range; verify live with two source IPs and the 429 metric series.

title: Dev/prod compose parity gaps on security-relevant keys
evidence: deploy/docker-compose.dev.yml:333 ALLOW_MOCK_ATTESTATION default true vs prod.yml:519 false (subagent)
prod.yml:448-585 HFSPACE/HF_TOKEN/large-provider and sandbox limit keys absent from dev (subagent)
current_behavior: Dev sandbox would attach to a network name compose does not create (CODE-PRESENT / BEHAVIOR UNVERIFIED); dev accepts mock attestation by default; sandbox resource limits unset in dev.
expected_behavior: The two files differ only in project name, ports and secrets.
recommendation: Align the listed keys; extend the compose-plumbing parity tests to sandbox and attestation keys.

title: Secret-literal fitness test scans gitignored files and fails on developer checkouts; stale secret copies on disk
evidence: EXECUTED-HERE: tests/architecture/test_no_committed_client_secrets.py:200 fails on deploy/.env:4, deploy/.env.bak-20260914-134105:4 (Google OAuth client secret), aura_backend/credentials.json:5 (private key)
current_behavior: Nothing is committed, but the test cannot distinguish tracked from untracked files, and a 2026-09-14 .env backup plus a service-account private key sit in plaintext beside the checkout.
expected_behavior: The test checks the committed tree only; no stale secret copies on disk.
recommendation: Scope the scan to git ls-files; owner deletes deploy/.env.bak-20260914-134105 and moves credentials.json out of the repo directory (rotate if provenance is unclear). Values redacted in this report.

title: Every Celery worker imports the legacy RAG service at module scope, which opens (or silently creates) a Qdrant client at import
evidence: aura_backend/services/rag.py:374 rag_service = RAGService() at module level
aura_backend/tests/architecture/test_dependency_rules.py:594-617 bans this pattern inside aura_core only
current_behavior: Realtime/training workers construct a Qdrant client at import; with QDRANT_HOST unset a private sqlite Qdrant is created that nothing reads. Only the A-02 tasks use it, so today's effect is import-time coupling.
expected_behavior: Workers connect lazily and only to the stores their queue needs.
recommendation: Move the services.rag import inside the two ingestion tasks or delete them with A-02; keep tasks.py importable without infrastructure.
